The '''SD-48 survival backpack''' was a type of [[backpack]] utilized by the [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Each backpack was fitted with a coolant unit, and was stocked with a supply of rations and [[water]].<ref name="Helmet" />
